Key.English: Set in game player options such as view distance, respawn, player persistence, crew info, player tags and more
Key.Chinesesimp: 设置游戏玩家选项,如视野距离,重生,玩家持久性,乘员信息,玩家标签等
Key.Spanish: Configura opciones de jugador en el juego, como la distancia de visión, la reaparición, la persistencia de jugador, la info de tripulación, las etiquetas de jugador y más
Solo se permite una plantilla de módulo

Key.English: Over-ride default parameters for the Module Template
Key.Chinesesimp: 覆盖模块模板的默认参数
Key.Spanish: Anula los parámetros por defecto de la plantilla de módulo

Key.English: Simply place the ALiVE Player Options module and set the appropriate parameters. You do not need to sync, position or orientate this module.
Key.Chinesesimp: 简单地放置ALIVE玩家选项模块,并设置适当的参数。你不需要同步,或定位这个模块。
Key.Spanish: Simplemente coloca el módulo Opciones de jugador de ALiVE y ajusta los parámetros correspondientes. No necesitas sincronizarlo, colocarlo ni orientarlo de ninguna forma concreta.

Key.English: Reinitialise the ALiVE SYS Marker Store locally
Key.Chinesesimp: 在本地重新初始化ALIVE SYS标记存储
Key.Spanish: Reinicializa localmente el almacén de marcadores de ALiVE

Key.English: Allow ACE Fatigue And Sway Options

With ACE loaded, players get an ACE menu in Player Options to make their own ACE fatigue lighter and their own weapon sway smaller. Settings the server or mission forces always win. Choices last until the player leaves.
Your own ACE fatigue and weapon sway, if the mission allows it
Light fatigue gives your soldier the fitness ACE allows at most: you still tire, but recover very quickly
Scales your own weapon sway on top of the server setting
Set by the server or mission
